=== JOB FAMILIES ===
- id: it-project-delivery
  label: IT Project Manager
  scope: Running the delivery of technology work — software, systems, platforms, data or IT infrastructure — from planning through completion: scope and plan, timeline and budget, risks and dependencies, coordinating the business and technical groups involved, and reporting progress. The thing delivered is technology; the employer's industry is irrelevant. Covers every seniority from coordinator to director, one delivery or a portfolio of them, and any working method.
  must-haves:
  - end-to-end-delivery: owned delivery from planning through completion
  - stakeholder-coordination: coordinated the business and technical groups involved
  - risk-dependency-control: acted on delivery risks, dependencies, timelines or budgets
  - delivery-communication: reported progress / translated delivery detail for stakeholders

=== JOB PLACEMENTS ===

- j2: Project Coordinator — Baltic Software House → none
